description: Real coverage of the Slovak methodological guidance corpus, computed from the data: one row per source (fonte) with the number of documents, first and last year, documents per section (jsonb), the text_source mix pdf/ocr (jsonb), OCR documents, passages total and passages still without embedding, skipped items by reason (jsonb), the last coverage rows listed/taken/skipped with a note (jsonb array), duplicate identity groups (informative), the last ingestion and a text with the honest limits. An empty corpus answers one row of zeros (fonte null). No parameters.
